Create, list, or destroy persistent EC2 hosts with rootless Podman

Usage: mj ec2 [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create   Launch a host (Ubuntu with rootless Podman, or Amazon Linux with Nitro Sandboxes) and add an SSH machine/target. Charges continue until you stop or destroy the VM
  list     List mj-managed VMs and unfinished local provisioning operations
  destroy  Terminate a managed VM and delete its disks, sessions, keys, and target. Also cleans up an interrupted create; accepts its operation ID
  tune     Re-apply mj's host tuning (kernel limits) to an existing managed host, so hosts made before a tuning change do not need to be recreated
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>  Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --no-splash        Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
  -h, --help             Print help
